newsitem.title: UK: LPC-United News gets 300 mln stg loan for Blenheim.
newsitem.headline: LPC-United News gets 300 mln stg loan for Blenheim.

text.p: LONDON, Oct 29 (LPC) - United News & Media have put in place a 300 million pound financing package to support their 592.5 million pound agreed purchase of exhibitions organiser Blenheim, public documents show.

The deal, arranged and underwritten by Chase Investment Bank and Lloyds Bank, is split between a 150 million pound revolving credit facility and a 150 million pound term loan. The revolver has a maturity of 364 days and is priced at 20 bps over LIBOR. The term loan has a maturity of three years and is priced at 22.5 bps over LIBOR. Both tranches have a commitment fee of 7.5 bps.
The facility will be used to finance the Blenheim purchase, refinance Blenheim's debt and for general corporate purposes. Borrowers are named as United News and Media, MAI plc and United Finance.
The acquisition will create the world's largest trade exhibition group with a turnover of 500 million pounds, based on 1995 figures.

Covenants include stipulations that total consolidated net borrowings shall not exceed 3 times consolidated profit before interest and tax. And also that the ratio of consolidated profit before interest and tax to consolidated net finance charges should not be less than 2.5:1.
